comment: The one place the Hearth sink screen's tokens are written (planning/hearth-sink-screen.md, Tokens and Layout; planning/hearth-android.md, D13). The Android app's Tokens.kt is generated from this file, and the checks hold the desktop's Signal palette (apps/shared/theme/assets/qml/Theme.qml) and the P4X panel's screen (firmware/hearth-sink/main/panel/lvgl/lyric_screen.cpp) to it. Change a value here, run tools/checks/sink_screen_tokens.py --write, and read what the check says of the others.
palette: signal, dark: a sink is a thing in a dim room and always draws dark, whatever the OS theme is
